close.confirmTitle: Close Orchester while agents are working?
close.confirmDetail: Closing stops the runner and every agent in it. Orchester has no background mode, so nothing keeps running after the window closes.
close.waitingDetail: No new steps or tool calls will start. Each agent is finishing its current work up to the next checkpoint. Orchester closes when every run is saved and paused.
close.waitForAgentsDetail: No new steps or tool calls start. Each agent continues to its next checkpoint, the runs are marked paused, then Orchester closes. This can take a few minutes. Resume the runs as usual next time.
close.quitNowDetail: Stops the runner and agents immediately. Work after each run's last checkpoint is not recorded as progress. Uncommitted changes stay in the worktree and are shown on next start.
close.waitingNote: Taking too long? Quit now stops the remaining agents. Their runs keep the last checkpoint they already saved; work after it is not recorded as progress.

recovery.title: The last session ended before agents could save

quitNow.one: Orchester was closed with Quit now and 1 run was interrupted. Nothing has been restarted. Continue it from its last checkpoint, or leave it interrupted; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.
quitNow.other: Orchester was closed with Quit now and {{count}} runs were interrupted. Nothing has been restarted. Continue all of them from their last checkpoints, or none; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.

crashed.one: Orchester stopped unexpectedly and 1 run was interrupted. Nothing has been restarted. Continue it from its last checkpoint, or leave it interrupted; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.
crashed.other: Orchester stopped unexpectedly and {{count}} runs were interrupted. Nothing has been restarted. Continue all of them from their last checkpoints, or none; work after a checkpoint is not counted as done.

recovery.note: Uncommitted changes are kept in each run’s worktree and are never discarded silently. If you don’t continue now, you can continue each run later from its task page.
recovery.notContinued: Not every run continued: {{reason}} The others stay interrupted; continue them later from their task pages.

permissions.pendingTitle: Applying new permissions at the next checkpoint…
permissions.pendingDetail: {{agent}} finishes the command it is running, then stops. Its changes are committed as a checkpoint and {{step}} restarts from it with the new permissions. Nothing in the worktree is lost; the agent’s unsaved reasoning since its last turn is not carried over unless the CLI can resume its session.
permissions.appliedDetail: {{agent}} restarted {{step}} from checkpoint {{checkpoint}} (invocation {{invocation}}). The earlier invocation’s transcript stays in Activity.
permissions.appliedDetailNoCheckpoint: {{agent}} restarted {{step}} as invocation {{invocation}}; nothing had changed since the last checkpoint. The earlier invocation’s transcript stays in Activity.

popover.title: Permissions for this run
popover.subtitle: {{agent}} · {{step}} · {{connection}} / {{model}} · from profile {{version}}

popover.saveToProfileDetail: Adds the change to draft v{{version}}. New runs get it after you publish.

errors.notEnforceable: {{step}} can’t run with these permissions on its connection. Choose options the connection can enforce.
errors.noAgentToRestart: No agent of this profile is at work now, so none can restart. Apply from the next invocation instead.
errors.noPending: The new permissions were already applied; there is no restart left to cancel.

notice.draftDetail: A run starts from Create & run once the task has every detail.
notice.queuedDetail: The task is queued. Its run starts when the runner accepts it; Create & run on the new task form retries without starting a second run.
notice.runningDetail: The agent works in the run’s own worktree and branch; your checkout is not touched.
notice.pausingDetail: The agent finishes the invocation it is running and its work is committed as a checkpoint; then the run pauses. Nothing in the worktree is lost.
notice.askingDetail: Answer it in the task conversation. {{step}} goes on with your answer.
notice.pausedDetail: Work is preserved. No new steps or tool calls start until you resume this run.
notice.interruptedDetail: Its agent was stopped when the runner or Orchester stopped. The run keeps its last checkpoint; Continue run starts it again from there and repeats the unfinished part of the step. Work after the checkpoint is not counted as done.
notice.reconnectingDetail: The runner stopped unexpectedly and Orchester is reconnecting to it. The run keeps its last checkpoint and continues from it automatically once the runner is back; work after the checkpoint is not counted as done.
notice.offlineDetail: Orchester could not restart the runner, so nothing runs. The run keeps its last checkpoint and continues from it once the runner is restarted; work after the checkpoint is not counted as done.
notice.notConnectedDetail: The runner is not connected, so its agent is not working. The run keeps its last checkpoint; work after the checkpoint is not counted as done.
notice.succeededDetail: The run’s changes are committed on {{branch}}.
notice.failedDetail: Activity shows what the agent reported.
notice.failedCommandDetail: Activity shows the command, its exit code and its output.

retryLimit.detail: Automatic execution has stopped. Review what the latest attempt left behind.
retryLimit.preservedDetail: The work of every step stays committed on {{branch}}. Nothing was merged into your branch.
retryLimit.unavailable: Allowing another attempt is not available in this version yet. The run stays failed and its work stays on its branch.

activity.declinedDetail: Blocked by this run’s permissions. The agent was told and continued without it.
activity.error: The agent CLI reported an error
activity.notSignedIn: The agent CLI is not signed in

failure.title: Not merged into {{branch}}
failure.wrongBranch: Your checkout is on {{current}}, not {{branch}}. Switch it to {{branch}}, then merge again. Nothing was changed.
failure.detached: Your checkout has a detached HEAD. Switch it to {{branch}}, then merge again. Nothing was changed.
failure.uncommitted: Your checkout has uncommitted changes: {{files}}. Commit or stash them yourself, then merge again. Nothing was changed.
failure.inProgress: A merge, cherry-pick or revert is in progress in your checkout. Finish or abort it, then merge again. Nothing was changed.
failure.conflict: The run’s changes conflict with your branch in {{files}}. The merge was undone, so your checkout is as it was. Merge the run’s branch yourself to resolve the conflicts.
failure.branchMissing: The run’s branch {{branch}} no longer exists, so there is nothing to merge.
failure.refused: Git didn’t merge, and the merge was undone: {{detail}}
failure.noBaseBranch: This run didn’t record the branch your checkout had when it started.

explanation.other: Removes them from .orchester/worktrees with everything in them, build output included. Committed work stays on the branches: a branch whose commits are merged is deleted, the others are kept.

limits.maxDetail: The largest token budget a task, a run or a raised limit may have. Budget fields reject larger values and name this maximum. There is no minimum beyond more than 0.
limits.defaultDetail: Prefilled in New task. Must not exceed the maximum.
limits.dailyDetail: Tokens all runs in this project may use per day. Shown in the status bar; new work waits once it is used up.
limits.timeLimitDetail: Counts active agent time only. Time paused or waiting for you (plan approval, questions, permission requests) doesn’t count.

environment.targetTitle: Share one build folder between run worktrees

versions.title: How versions work
versions.draftDetail: Edits are saved as a draft. Tasks and runs never use a draft.
versions.publishDetail: Publishing turns the draft into the next version. New runs use it.

empty.title: No pipelines in {{project}} yet

steps.runChecks: Tool · Run test suite · in parallel with Review
steps.review: Reviewer · in parallel with Run checks

empty.starterResult: Creates draft v1 with these steps. Review it and publish v1 before a task can use it. The steps use {{project}}’s Explorer, Planner, Builder and Reviewer profiles and the Run test suite and Create pull request tools; anything missing is flagged in the editor.

create.title: New pipeline
create.explanation: Creates draft v1 in {{project}}. Tasks can use it after you publish it.
create.name: Name

create.starterDetail: Six steps from a brief to a reviewed pull request. You approve the plan and review the pull request.
create.starterSteps: Research → Plan (approval) → Implement → Run checks ∥ Review → Create pull request
create.emptyDetail: No steps. Add them yourself in the editor.

research.name: Research
research.instructions: Study the repository and the task brief. Report the code involved, the constraints and the risks, and anything the brief leaves open.

plan.name: Plan
plan.instructions: Propose a plan for the task: the changes to make, their order and how each acceptance criterion will be checked. Wait for approval before anything is implemented.

implement.name: Implement
implement.instructions: Implement the approved plan with tests. Keep changes within the task’s scope and explain anything that differs from the plan.

runChecks.name: Run checks
runChecks.instructions: Run the project’s tests, linters and other checks against the implementation.

review.name: Review
review.instructions: Review the implementation against the task’s acceptance criteria. Check correctness, edge cases and maintainability, and link each finding to the relevant code.

createPullRequest.name: Create pull request
createPullRequest.instructions: Open a pull request with a summary of the changes and the evidence that each acceptance criterion is met.
